title: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker, ravaged and lashed to slag by Norn's choir, who still feels pain and is rescued by his friends.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker reborn as a winged angel in golden armor who arrives to save Karn and fights Elesh Norn so the Mirrans can escape.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who rules the Invasion Tree sanctuary and builds armor from fallen soldiers while trying to persuade or crush Elspeth.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A praetor who obeys Norn but questions her; Norn tears off his arm when he suggests retreating.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who taunts Karn and has a horn snapped off by Norn.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A Mirran planeswalker who calls magma from the bridge and leads the retreat to the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker healed by Elspeth who carries Wrenn toward the tree but cannot bring herself to hurt Nissa.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who can no longer walk and needs to reach the Invasion Tree to find Teferi.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran immune to phyresis who rescues Karn but is struck down by spears.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Phyrexianized elven planeswalker who hunts the fleeing Mirrans, flinging fallen bodies at them.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A dead inventor who sacrificed his spark to save Karn, whose spark now lends Karn strength.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Karn's creation who lost his way and ruled Mirrodin.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A past figure who told Karn that people are less likely to hurt something that screams.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker Wrenn believes will know what to do, who has gone somewhere reachable only through the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Elspeth recalls as Phyrexianized and content.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Elspeth recalls looking ecstatic in her new Phyrexian state.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: An undying friend of Elspeth she imagines joining them.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The Phyrexian armies and the choir that holds Karn aloft and attacks the fleeing Mirrans.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: Mirran survivors and rescuers who flee toward the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: The Phyrexian structure on Mirrodin that the Mirrans must reach to escape.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane where the bridge and Invasion Tree stand and where Karn's former failures took place.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: Elspeth's crackling golden blade, a facsimile of the original that works for her.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: Phyrexian corruption that overtook Karn and which Elspeth was horrified by.

entities.name: The fall of Mirrodin
entities.description: The earlier collapse of Mirrodin that Karn blames on himself.

events.summary: In a flashback, Karn recalls leaving word not to follow him when he first tried to solve Mirrodin's Phyrexian problem, and being saved by Venser's sacrifice.
events.quote: If it wasn't for Venser sacrificing his spark, Karn would be dead.

events.summary: Karn, lashed to slag held aloft by Norn's choir, is being taken apart as Norn taunts him.
events.quote: The Phyrexians have been taking him apart, piece by piece, and repurposing his silver body.

events.summary: Norn calls Karn the False Patriarch and demands he answer Phyrexia; Jin-Gitaxias raises his claws to strike Karn.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias raises an arm to strike.

events.summary: Elspeth arrives as an angel in golden armor, blocking Jin-Gitaxias's strike and sending his legions into the abyss.
events.quote: An angel in gleaming armor, a golden blade now raised to counter Jin-Gitaxias's strike.

events.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra and Koth while Norn rages, throwing pieces of her throne that shatter against Elspeth's wing.
events.quote: Healing light flows from her into the pyromancer.

events.summary: Phyrexian ranks falter and Koth, healed, calls magma and rallies the Mirrans.
Norn grabs Jin-Gitaxias by the throat when he suggests retreating, then orders him and Nissa to deal with the prisoners.
Wrenn, who can no longer walk, asks Chandra to carry her toward the Invasion Tree.
Melira frees Karn's platform and Koth uses stone to bring Karn along with the fleeing group.
events.quote: Karn's slab flies out to meet them.

events.summary: Nissa pursues the fleeing group, flinging bodies at them and threatening to kill Chandra unless she drops Wrenn.
events.quote: "Drop the dryad and there's still hope for you, Chandra.

events.summary: Norn pulls Elspeth from the air and builds new armor from fallen Phyrexians, while Elspeth burns it with a beam from Godsend.
events.quote: A little focus is all it takes to send a searing beam of light at Norn.

events.summary: Norn raises walls to block Elspeth and tries to persuade her that her wings make her a Phyrexian.
events.quote: What does this form offer you that Phyrexia cannot?

events.summary: Elspeth is tempted by Norn's vision of unity with friends such as Ajani and Daxos, but denies they are alike.
events.quote: And though she is loath to admit it, there is truth to what Norn is saying.

events.summary: Norn tears off Jin-Gitaxias's arm for suggesting she compleat Elspeth, and Elspeth stabs Norn's shoulder, making her bleed and escaping her grip.
events.quote: She drives her sword into Norn's wounded shoulder

events.summary: Melira is struck down by Phyrexian spears on the bridge as Koth screams.
events.quote: That person crumpling to the ground—is that Melira?

events.summary: Elspeth argues that Norn wants worship for herself, not Phyrexia, enraging Norn who hurls blades.
events.quote: Power's the only thing you care about.

events.summary: Elspeth dodges Norn's blade storm with a sharp turn and unleashes a ray of light, then flies toward the tree to ensure Wrenn and Chandra make it.
events.quote: With all her problems concentrated in one place, Elspeth at last unleashes a ray of light.

relations.note: Norn calls Karn the False Patriarch and tortures him
Norn is the Grand Praetor whose will is Phyrexia's

relations.quote: Jin-Gitaxias calls out to his liege.

relations.note: Venser sacrificed his spark to save Karn
relations.quote: Time and time again Karn swore that he'd do honor to Venser's memory.

relations.note: Karn left one of his own creations in charge of Mirrodin
relations.quote: in his hubris, he'd left one of his own creations in charge of it
In his arrogance, he'd shaped the plane

relations.note: Elspeth fights Norn and wounds her
relations.quote: it is finally time to strike down Elesh Norn.

relations.note: Elspeth heals Koth and protects the Mirran escape
relations.quote: she keeps her attention on Chandra, then on Koth.
You're smart enough to know I'll kill you otherwise.
